A '''Geo Beast Brain''' was a gelatinous [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]] made from the [[Brain/Legends|brain]] of a [[Geo Beast]]. It was served during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and sourced from larval Geo Beasts around the [[Glacial Fissure]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Brains" /> The brains could be used in dishes such as [[braised scyk belly]].<ref name="Exotic" />
